note: The adjudicators are language models, not humans (owner decision, 2026-10-28). They share training data and priors with the author of the classifier, so their independence is weaker than a human's. Blinding, the prior-committed rubric, the inter-rater check and the negative control are what stand in for human scrutiny. WARNING: verdicts_1.json and verdicts_2.json are byte-identical (sha256 6af6a880f0e253cfe73dd26ae2225f6dad8c3fa445233665703cceaad2417e58). Identical files cannot serve as two independent raters — one run copied twice, or two deterministic runs with no measurable disagreement. The inter-rater check is forced to fail.
